summary: Accept both client API wire names in web publisher startup credential checks

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: Web publisher credential checks now accept both st3.client.v0 and fractal.client.v0 capabilities responses, restoring startup against daemons from 1cf83b29 onward. Unknown API versions remain rejected; read-only scope requirements are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption beyond the normal publisher restart to load updated code; restart duration is not measured.

manual.detail: No credential or configuration changes are needed.

recovery.detail: No persisted state changes. Reverting restores the prior rejection of fractal.client.v0 capabilities responses.
